logit-lens.note: the lens puts the final prediction on top long before it gives it any probability: the last block multiplies the size of the stream (root mean square 1072 before it, 4568 after), so the direction the readout sees is mostly written by the last block. A tuned lens (an affine map of the stream per block, fitted on 204800 other held-out positions to minimize D(final || lens)) is 4.61 bits from the final distribution after block 1, 3.08 after block 6 and 0.68 after block 11, against 9.51, 8.57 and 4.12 for the logit lens: at the early blocks of this recipe the logit lens needs the tuned lens

neurons-as-memories.note: same_last: mean share of a neuron's strongest triggers that end in its commonest trigger token (an automatic stand-in for the annotators' shallow patterns); agreement: share of neurons whose top-scoring token is the token after their strongest trigger (the papers' agreement rate); follows: mean share of strongest triggers followed by one of the value's top tokens; *_shuffled: the same with values dealt to other neurons of the block; chance.same_last: for positions drawn at random. gpt-pp's units are squared ReLUs: coefficients are never negative
